description:
Header comment still reads 'Entry / identity panel for cam-cli.'; cosmetic staleness now that the product is CAM Runtime. Non-blocking.

spec.scope: Update the single stale product-name token in the file-header comment of src/ui/Splash.tsx line 3: replace 'Entry / identity panel for cam-cli.' with 'Entry / identity panel for CAM Runtime.' The product display-name is now CAM Runtime; the phrase 'Entry / identity panel' is already accurate and stays. This is a comment-only change with zero runtime/render effect.
acceptanceCriteria: src/ui/Splash.tsx line 3 header comment reads 'Entry / identity panel for CAM Runtime.' and the stale 'cam-cli' product reference is gone.

No other line in src/ui/Splash.tsx is changed; in particular the url default 'eduardocaminha/cam-cli' (~line 100) is left byte-for-byte unchanged because it is the real GitHub repo slug, not a product display-name.
bun run typecheck passes with zero errors and the full bun test suite passes (behavior is unchanged; no test asserts on the comment text).
gotchas: Line 100 `url = 'eduardocaminha/cam-cli'` is a real repo slug rendered at runtime as `v{version} · {url}`; MUST NOT be touched. A blind global s/cam-cli/CAM Runtime/ over the file would corrupt the runtime-rendered repo URL. Scope the edit strictly to the line-3 header comment.

This is a pure source-comment change with no JSX/rendered-output effect: the Splash panel already renders the 'CAM Runtime' identity (block wordmark + 'Runtime' line). Do not alter any rendered output or JSX.
domainTerms: CAM Runtime: the human-facing product display-name. The `cam` command name and internal identifiers (GitHub repo slug eduardocaminha/cam-cli, package name) stay unchanged; only human-facing prose adopts CAM Runtime.
